known.article: Crystal Springs of Napa Valley AVA
known.via: English Wikipedia "Crystal Springs of Napa Valley AVA"

blurb.text: A small California AVA created in 2024 inside Napa Valley, overlapping none of its neighbors. Its borders were drawn to take in the Crystal Springs Vineyard, part of which had been in Calistoga.
